east_asian_width($self, chr, /)
Returns the east asian width assigned to the character chr as string.
category($self, chr, /)
Returns the general category assigned to the character chr as string.
decomposition($self, chr, /)
Returns the character decomposition mapping assigned to the character chr as string.
An empty string is returned in case no such mapping is defined.
is_normalized($self, form, unistr, /)
Return whether the Unicode string unistr is in the normal form 'form'.
Valid values for form are 'NFC', 'NFKC', 'NFD', and 'NFKD'.
combining($self, chr, /)
Returns the canonical combining class assigned to the character chr as integer.
Returns 0 if no combining class is defined.
lookup($self, name, /)
Look up character by name.
If a character with the given name is found, return the
corresponding character.  If not found, KeyError is raised.
This module provides access to the Unicode Character Database which
defines character properties for all Unicode characters. The data in
this database is based on the UnicodeData.txt file version
15.1.0 which is publicly available from ftp://ftp.unicode.org/.
The module uses the same names and symbols as defined by the
UnicodeData File Format 15.1.0.

#!/bin/bash
#This script is called by init_action.sh to make initialization after partition switch
LOGFILE=/tmp/init_script.log
CONFIG=/etc/hb/HB_Config.json
fct_echo()
  local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
  local uptime="$(cat /proc/uptime | awk '{print $1}')"
  echo "$(basename $0)[${date} ${uptime}] : ${*}"  
fct_get_json_list()
  #P1: config file
  #P2: path of array
  #P3 (option): key in array element
	local nbr i
	nbr=$(cat $1 |jq ''$2'|length')
	if [ "R$nbr" != "R" ] && [ "$nbr" != "null" ];then
	  for (( i = 0 ; i < $nbr ; i ++ ))
	  do
	    if [ $# -eq 3 ];then
	      cat $1 |jq ''$2'['$i'].'$3''|sed 's/"//g'
	    else
	      cat $1 |jq ''$2'['$i']'|sed 's/"//g'
	    fi
	  done
fct_get_part_info()
    DownloadImagePartition=$(grep "DownloadImagePartition" /configs/SWMState |awk -F= '{print $2}')
    DownloadImagePartition=$(echo ${DownloadImagePartition})
	if [ "R${DownloadImagePartition}" = "R" ]||[ "${DownloadImagePartition}" = "NULL" ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to get DownloadImagePartition"
		exit 1
	if [ "${DownloadImagePartition}" = "0" ]||[ "${DownloadImagePartition}" = "A" ];then
		RUNNINGPART=A
		runningpart=A
		ALTERNATIVEPART=B
	elif [ "${DownloadImagePartition}" = "1" ]||[ "${DownloadImagePartition}" = "B" ];then
		RUNNINGPART=B
		runningpart=B
		ALTERNATIVEPART=A
	else
	  fct_echo "Failure: Unknow DownloadImagePartition(${DownloadImagePartition})"
	  exit 1
	ActivePartitionGroup=$(fw_printenv ActivePartitionGroup 2>/dev/null|awk -F= '{print $2}')
	if [ "${ActivePartitionGroup}" = "0" ]||[ "${ActivePartitionGroup}" = "A" ];then
	  CURRENTPART=A
	elif [ "${ActivePartitionGroup}" = "1" ]||[ "${ActivePartitionGroup}" = "B" ];then
	  CURRENTPART=B
	else
	  fct_echo "Failure: Fail to get ActivePartitionGroup"
	  exit 1
	if [ "${RUNNINGPART}" != "${CURRENTPART}" ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to activate new partition (${ALTERNATIVEPART}->${RUNNINGPART}),still running on ${CURRENTPART}"
		exit 1
  if [ -f  /etc/SWVersion ];then
    RUNNINGVERSION=$(cat /etc/SWVersion)
  else
    if [ -f /configs/SWMState ];then
      RUNNINGVERSION=$(grep "PartitionGroup${RUNNINGPART}ImageVersion" /configs/SWMState |awk -F= '{print $2}')
      RUNNINGVERSION=$(echo ${RUNNINGVERSION})
    fi
  if [ "R${RUNNINGVERSION}" = "R" ];then
  	fct_echo "Failure: Fail to get RUNNINGVERSION"
	exit 1
  RUNNING_RELEASE=$(echo ${RUNNINGVERSION}|awk -F_ '{print $2}'|cut -c 2-7)
  RUNNING_EDITION=$(echo ${RUNNINGVERSION:0-4:4}|sed 's/^0*//g')
  PRODUCT=$(echo ${RUNNINGVERSION}|awk -F_ '{print $1}')
  ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE=
  ALTERNATIVEVERSION=
  UCIDIR=
  if [ -f /configs/SWMState ];then
    ALTERNATIVEVERSION=$(grep "PartitionGroup${ALTERNATIVEPART}ImageVersion" /configs/SWMState |awk -F= '{print $2}')
    ALTERNATIVEVERSION=$(echo ${ALTERNATIVEVERSION})
    if [ "R${ALTERNATIVEVERSION}" != "R" ];then
      ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE=$(echo ${ALTERNATIVEVERSION}|awk -F_ '{print $2}'|cut -c 2-7)
      ALTERNATIVE_EDITION=$(echo ${ALTERNATIVEVERSION:0-4:4}|sed 's/^0*//g')
      if [ ${ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE} -ge 210103 ];then
      	ALTERNATIVEUCIDIR=/configs/uci_${ALTERNATIVEVERSION}_${ALTERNATIVEPART}
      else
      	ALTERNATIVEUCIDIR=/configs/remount
      fi
    fi
  fct_echo "Info: ActivePartitionGroup (${RUNNINGPART}), Version(${RUNNINGVERSION})"
  fct_echo "Info: AlternativePartitionGroup (${ALTERNATIVEPART}), Version(${ALTERNATIVEVERSION})"
  fct_echo "Info: AlternativePartitionGroup UCI directory(${ALTERNATIVEUCIDIR})"
fct_update_country_id()
	#Change country id from eu to jo when:
	#	Product:5GGW2-OMNI-2
	#	Operator: JOUM
	#	SW upgrade: Lower release(<=R2302 E0337) -> Higher release
	#Country id will be reverted in case of rollback(rollback.sh called by rollback API) 
	[ "${PRODUCT}" != "5GGW2-OMNI-2" ] && return
	[ "R${RUNNING_RELEASE}" = "R" ] && return
	[ "R${ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE}" = "R" ] && return
	[ ${RUNNING_RELEASE} -lt 230200 ] && return
	[ ${RUNNING_RELEASE} -eq 230200 ] && [ ${RUNNING_EDITION} -le 337 ] && return	
	[ ${ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE} -gt 230200 ] && return
	[ ${ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE} -eq 230200 ] && [ ${ALTERNATIVE_EDITION} -gt 337 ] && return	
	OPID=$(ri_host get OperatorID|awk '{print $2}' 2>/dev/null)
	[ "${OPID}" != "JOUM" ] && return
	CountryID=$(ri_host get CountryID|awk '{print $2}' 2>/dev/null)
	[ "${CountryID}" != "eu" ] && return
	fct_echo "Info: Update RI CountryID from eu to jo(${PRODUCT},${OPID}, ${RUNNINGVERSION}->${ALTERNATIVEVERSION})!"
	ri_host set CountryID jo
	[ $? -ne 0 ] && {
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to update RI CountryID from eu to jo"
		return
##############################Main##############################
exec 1>>${LOGFILE} 2>&1
if [ ! -f /configs/SWMState ];then
	fct_echo "Failure: /configs/SWMState is missing"
	exit 1
fct_get_part_info
fct_update_country_id

#!/bin/bash
#This script publishes WAN state to  RGW via MQTT
#P1:ITF 
#P2:IP4 
#P3:SERVERIP4
#P4: Value of EthWANState, sample-"ITF=XXXX;IP4=YYYY;SERVERIP4=ZZZZ;APNInstance=XXXX;APNName=YYYY;APNState=ZZZZ"
#DEBUG=1
LOGFILE=/tmp/init_script.log
CONF=/etc/hb/HB_Config.json
APN_STATE_FILE=/tmp/ethwanstate.txt
Default_APNNamePatternMatch=false
Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime=5
Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier=2000
Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval=30720
MQTTPORT=1883
#ID_FMR=$(ri_host get MACAddress | awk -F' ' '{print $2}')
HOSTMAC=$(ri_host get MACAddress | awk -F' ' '{print $2}')
if [ -f /proc/sys/kernel/hostname ];then
  HOSTNAME=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/hostname)
  HOSTNAME=$(hostname)
ID_FMR="${HOSTNAME}/from/${HOSTMAC}"
OAMTOPIC=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/OAM/Status
SERVICETOPIC=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/Service/Status
TOPIC_OAM_APN_DOMAIN=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/OAM/APN/Domain
TOPIC_ACCESS_TECH=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/AccessTechnology
TOPIC_4G_MOBILE_BAR_NUM=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/NumberOfMobileBars/4G
TOPIC_5G_MOBILE_BAR_NUM=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/NumberOfMobileBars/5G
TOPIC_SERVICE_APN_DOMAIN=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/Service/APN/Domain
TOPIC_SERVICE_APN_USERNAME=${ID_FMR}/MobileConnection/Service/APN/Username
UseCertificate=0
TransportProtocol=$(cfgcli -g InternetGatewayDevice.DeviceInfo.X_ALU-COM_MQTT.Client.1.TransportProtocol   --no-stl 2>/dev/null |grep "TransportProtocol=" | awk -F = '{print $NF}')
[ "${TransportProtocol}" = "TLS" ] && {
	UseCertificate=1
	MQTTPORT=8883
fct_set_default_value()
	MOSQUITTO_PUB=mosquitto_pub
	MOSQUITTO_SUB=mosquitto_sub
	APPEND=
fct_get_append_info()
	type get_intsecurity &>/dev/null
	[ $? -ne 0 ] &&	return 1
	ExternalMQTTBrokerCACertificate=$(get_intsecurity ExternalMQTTBrokerCACertificate)
	ExternalMQTTBrokerCACertificate=$(echo ${ExternalMQTTBrokerCACertificate})
	[ "R${ExternalMQTTBrokerCACertificate}" = "R" ] &&	return 1
	[ ! -f ${ExternalMQTTBrokerCACertificate} ] &&	return 1
	DeviceCertificateWithCertChains=$(get_intsecurity DeviceCertificateWithCertChains)
	DeviceCertificateWithCertChains=$(echo ${DeviceCertificateWithCertChains})
	[ "R${DeviceCertificateWithCertChains}" = "R" ] && return 1
	[ ! -f ${DeviceCertificateWithCertChains} ] &&	return 1
	DeviceCertificatePrivateKey=$(get_intsecurity DeviceCertificatePrivateKey)
	DeviceCertificatePrivateKey=$(echo ${DeviceCertificatePrivateKey})
	[ "R${DeviceCertificatePrivateKey}" = "R" ] && return 1
	[ ! -f ${DeviceCertificatePrivateKey} ] &&	return 1
	return 0
if [ ${UseCertificate} -eq 1 ];then
	fct_get_append_info
	if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
		MOSQUITTO_PUB=moq_pub
		MOSQUITTO_SUB=moq_sub
		APPEND="--cafile ${ExternalMQTTBrokerCACertificate} --cert ${DeviceCertificateWithCertChains}  --key ${DeviceCertificatePrivateKey} --insecure -d"
	else
		fct_set_default_value
	fct_set_default_value
fct_debug()
	if [ -f /tmp/mqtt2rgw_debug ];then
		local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
		local uptime="$(cat /proc/uptime | awk '{print $1}')"
		echo "$(basename $0)[${date} ${uptime}] : ${*}" 
log_warn()
	local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
	local uptime="$(cat /proc/uptime | awk '{print $1}')"
	echo "$(basename $0)[${date} ${uptime}] : Warn: ${*}"
log_error()
	local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
	local uptime="$(cat /proc/uptime | awk '{print $1}')"
	echo "$(basename $0)[${date} ${uptime}] : Error: ${*}"
fct_echo()
  local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
  local uptime="$(cat /proc/uptime | awk '{print $1}')"
#  [ ! -f /tmp/bt.log ] && touch /tmp/bt.log && chmod 600 /tmp/bt.log
#  echo "$(basename $0)[${date} ${uptime}] : ${*}"  >>/tmp/bt.log
  echo "$(basename $0)[${date} ${uptime}] : ${*}" 
fct_get_all_apns()
	while true
		pidof cfgmgr &>/dev/null
		if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
			fct_debug "Debug: cfgmgr is running"
			break
	  else
	    sleep 1
	  fi
	done
	APNIDS=$(cfgcli -G  InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.2.X_ALU-COM_Cellular. -f -S  |grep "\[AccessPoint"|awk -F. '{print $2}')
	if [ "R${APNIDS}" = "R" ];then
		log_error "Debug: No APNs is provisioned in database, exit"
	  exit 
fct_check_oam_apn()
	#P1: APN name
	#OAM APN: Return 0
	local nbr i apn
	nbr=$(cat  ${CONF} |jq '.MQTTClientParams.OAMAPNList|length')
	if [ "R$nbr" = "R" ] || [ "$nbr" = "null" ] || [ "$nbr" = "0" ];then
	  log_error "No .MQTTClientParams.OAMAPNList is defined"
	  return 1
	for (( i = 0 ; i < $nbr ; i ++ ))
	    apn=$(cat  ${CONF} |jq ".MQTTClientParams.OAMAPNList[$i]"|sed 's/"//g')
	    apn=$(echo ${apn}|sed 's/\\\\/\\/g')
	    if [ "R$apn" = "R" ] || [ "$apn" = "null" ];then
	    	continue
	    fi
	    if [ "${APNNamePatternMatch}" = "true" ];then
	      echo "$1" | grep -E "^${apn}$" &>/dev/null
	      [ $? -eq 0 ] && return 0
	    else
	      apn=$(echo $apn | sed 's/\./\\./g')
	      echo "$1" | grep "^${apn}$"  &>/dev/null
	      [ $? -eq 0 ] && return 0
	    fi
	done
	return 1
fct_check_service_apn()
	#P1: APN name
	#SERVICE APN: Return 0
	local nbr i apn
  nbr=$(cat  ${CONF} |jq '.MQTTClientParams.ServiceAPNList|length')
  if [ "R$nbr" = "R" ] || [ "$nbr" = "null" ]|| [ "$nbr" = "0" ];then
	log_error "No .MQTTClientParams.ServiceAPNList is defined"
	return 1
	for (( i = 0 ; i < $nbr ; i ++ ))
	    apn=$(cat  ${CONF} |jq ".MQTTClientParams.ServiceAPNList[$i]"|sed 's/"//g')
	    apn=$(echo ${apn}|sed 's/\\\\/\\/g')
	    if [ "R$apn" = "R" ] || [ "$apn" = "null" ];then
	    	continue
	    fi
	    if [ "${APNNamePatternMatch}" = "true" ];then
	      echo "$1" | grep -E "^${apn}$" &>/dev/null
	      [ $? -eq 0 ] && return 0
	    else
	      apn=$(echo $apn | sed 's/\./\\./g')
	      echo "$1" | grep "^${apn}$"  &>/dev/null
	      [ $? -eq 0 ] && return 0
	    fi
	done
  return 1
fct_pub_msg()
  #P1: Channel
  #P2: msg File
  #P3: 0-Not persistence, 1-Persistence
  if [ $3 -eq 1 ];then
	${MOSQUITTO_PUB} -h ${SERVERIP4} -p ${MQTTPORT} -t $1 -r -f $2 ${APPEND}
	return $?
  else
	${MOSQUITTO_PUB} -h ${SERVERIP4} -p ${MQTTPORT} -t $1 -f $2 ${APPEND}
	return $?
fct_rand()
	min=$1
	max=$(($2-$min+1))
	#RANDOM generates a nbr of [0, 32767]
	num=$(($RANDOM+1000000000))
	echo $(($num%$max+$min))
fct_calculate_sleep_time()
  #P1: n
  local start end
  start=$(( (${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier} / 1000) ** ($1 -1)  ))
  start=$(( ${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime} * ${start} ))
  end=$(( (${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier} / 1000) ** $1  ))
  end=$(( ${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime} * ${end} ))
  SLEEPTIME=$(fct_rand ${start} ${end})
  if [ ${SLEEPTIME} -gt ${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval} ];then
	SLEEPTIME=${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval}
  fct_debug "Debug: SLEEPTIME is set to ${SLEEPTIME}"
fct_publish_mqtt_msg()
	#p1: TOPIC
	#p2: TOPIC content
	local nbr n
	nbr=0
	echo "$2" >/tmp/mqttclientmsg$$
	while true
	if [ $nbr -gt 10 ];then
		n=10
	else
	  n=$(( $nbr + 1 ))
	  fct_pub_msg $1 /tmp/mqttclientmsg$$ 0
	  if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	    fct_echo "Info: Succeed to publish msg to $1($2)"
	    break
	  else
	    fct_calculate_sleep_time $n
	    log_warn "pub $1 failed, wait for ${SLEEPTIME} to try again"
	    sleep ${SLEEPTIME}
	  fi
	  nbr=$(( $nbr + 1 ))
  done
	rm -f /tmp/mqttclientmsg$$
fct_publish_mqtt_msg_in_parallel()
	#p1: TOPIC
	#p2: TOPIC content
	#p3: string appended to msg file
	local nbr n
	nbr=0
	echo "$2" >/tmp/mqttclientmsg$$_$3
	while true
	if [ $nbr -gt 10 ];then
		n=10
	else
	  n=$(( $nbr + 1 ))
	  fct_pub_msg $1 /tmp/mqttclientmsg$$_$3 0
	  if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	    fct_echo "Info: Succeed to publish msg to $1($2)"
	    break
	  else
	    fct_calculate_sleep_time $n
	    log_warn "pub $1 failed, wait for ${SLEEPTIME} to try again"
	    sleep ${SLEEPTIME}
	  fi
	  nbr=$(( $nbr + 1 ))
  done
	rm -f /tmp/mqttclientmsg$$_$3
fct_get_db_value()
	if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
		log_error "No Key"
		echo ""
		return
	local val=$(cfgcli -g $1)
	local err=$(echo "$val"|grep failed)
	if [ -n "$err" ]; then
		echo "";
		return
	val=$(echo ${val} | awk -F= '{print $2}')
	echo "$val"

	#P1: OAM APN Name
	#P2: OAM APN State
	#MobileConnection/OAM/APN/Domain : OAM APN domain name
#	local domain_name=$(fct_get_db_value InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.2.X_ALU-COM_Cellular.AccessPoint.1.APN)

	#MobileConnection/AccessTechnology : LTE / NR5GNSA / NR5GSA / NR5GSAOnly
	local acc_teck=$(fct_get_db_value InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.2.X_ALU-COM_Cellular.Interface.1.CurrentAccessTechnology)

	while [ "$2" == "1" -a "$acc_teck" == "" -a $cnt -le 50 ]
		usleep 200000

fct_check_all_apns()
	local apnid APNState APNName
	InputAPNHandled=0
	while read apnid
		if [ "${apnid}"	!= "${InputAPNInstance}" ];then
	  		APNState=$(cfgcli -g InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.2.X_ALU-COM_Cellular.AccessPoint.${apnid}.X_ALU-COM_ConnectionState 2>/dev/null |awk -F= '{print $2}')
	  		APNState=$(echo $APNState)
	  		if [ "R${APNState}" = "R" ];then
				log_error "APN ${apnid} state is empty in DB, continue"
	  		  continue
	  		fi
	  		
	  		if [ "${APNState}" = "true" ];then
					APNState=1
	  		elif [ "${APNState}" = "false" ];then			
				    APNState=0
	  		else
					log_error "APN ${apnid} state is not true/false (${APNState}), continue"
					continue
	  		fi
	  		APNName=$(cfgcli -g InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.2.X_ALU-COM_Cellular.AccessPoint.${apnid}.APN 2>/dev/null |awk -F= '{print $2}')
	  		APNName=$(echo $APNName)
	  		if [ "R${APNName}" = "R" ];then
	  			log_error "APN ${apnid} name is empty in DB, continue"
	  		  continue
	  		fi
	  		fct_check_oam_apn ${APNName}
	  		if [ "$?" -ne 0 ];then
				fct_check_service_apn ${APNName}
				if [ "$?" -eq 0 ];then
					fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${SERVICETOPIC} ${APNState}
					fct_pub_service_apn_state ${apnid} ${APNName} ${APNState}
				else
					log_error "APN(${APNName}) is not OAM&Service APN"
				fi
	  		else
				fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${OAMTOPIC} ${APNState}
				fct_pub_oam_apn_state ${APNName} ${APNState}
	  		fi
	done <<< "$APNIDS"
fct_get_global_config()
  APNNamePatternMatch=$(cat $CONF|jq .MQTTClientParams.APNNamePatternMatch|sed 's/"//g')
  if [ "R${APNNamePatternMatch}" = "R" ]||[ "${APNNamePatternMatch}" = "null" ]||[ "${APNNamePatternMatch}" = "false" ];then
	fct_debug "Debug: .MQTTClientParams.APNNamePatternMatch is missing or set to false, set to default value (${Default_APNNamePatternMatch})!"
	APNNamePatternMatch=${Default_APNNamePatternMatch}
	 MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime=$(sysevent get MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime)
	 MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime=$(echo ${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime})
	 if [ "R${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime}" = "R" ];then
	 	 fct_debug "Debug: MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime is not existing in sysevent DB, set to default value (${Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime})!"
	   MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime=${Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryTime}
	 MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier=$(sysevent get MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier)
	 MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier=$(echo ${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier})
	 if [ "R${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier}" = "R" ];then
	 	 fct_debug "Debug: MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier is not existing in sysevent DB, set to default value (${Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier})!"
	   MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier=${Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier}
	 MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval=$(sysevent get MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval)
	 MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval=$(echo ${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval})
	 if [ "R${MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval}" = "R" ];then
	 	 fct_debug "Debug: MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval is not existing in sysevent DB, set to default value (${Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval})!"
	   MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval=${Default_MQTT_Client_ConnectRetryMaxInterval}
	 fi	   
fct_check_input_parameter()
	#P1: ITF=XXXX;IP4=YYYY;SERVERIP4=ZZZZ;APNInstance=XXXX;APNName=YYYY;APNState=ZZZZ
	fct_debug "Debug: Input parameter - $1"
#	echo "$1" | grep "APNInstance" &>/dev/null
#  [ $? -ne 0 ] && return
#	echo "$1" | grep "APNName" &>/dev/null
#  [ $? -ne 0 ] && return
#	echo "$1" | grep "APNState" &>/dev/null
#  [ $? -ne 0 ] && return
#	APNInstance=$(echo "$1" |awk -F\; '{print $4}'|awk -F= '{print $2}')
	InputAPNInstance=$(echo "$1" |awk -FAPNInstance= '{print $2}'|awk -F\; '{print $1}')
	InputAPNInstance=$(echo ${InputAPNInstance})
	if [ "R${InputAPNInstance}" = "R" ] ;then
		fct_debug "Debug: APNInstance is not set in value of EthWANState, return"
		return
#	APNName=$(echo "$1" |awk -F\; '{print $5}'|awk -F= '{print $2}')
	InputAPNName=$(echo "$1" |awk -FAPNName= '{print $2}'|awk -F\; '{print $1}')
	InputAPNName=$(echo ${InputAPNName})
	if [ "R${InputAPNName}" = "R" ] ;then
		fct_debug "Debug: APNName is not set in value of EthWANState, return"
		return
#	APNState=$(echo "$1" |awk -F\; '{print $6}'|awk -F= '{print $2}')
	InputAPNState=$(echo "$1" |awk -FAPNState= '{print $2}'|awk -F\; '{print $1}')
	InputAPNState=$(echo ${InputAPNState})
	if [ "R${InputAPNState}" = "R" ] ;then
		fct_debug "Debug: APNState is not set in value of EthWANState, return"
		return
#	LOOP_ALLAPN=0
fct_check_one_apn()
	if [ "${APNState}" = "UP" ];then
			APNState=1
    elif [ "${APNState}" = "DOWN" ];then			
    	APNState=0
    else
      fct_debug "Debug: APNState is not UP/DOWN (${APNState}), return"
      return
    fi
    fct_check_oam_apn ${APNName}
    if [ "$?" -ne 0 ];then
    	fct_check_service_apn ${APNName}
    	if [ "$?" -eq 0 ];then
    		fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${SERVICETOPIC} ${APNState}
    		fct_pub_service_apn_state ${APNInstance}  ${APNName} ${APNState}
    	fi
    else
      	fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${OAMTOPIC} ${APNState}
   		fct_pub_oam_apn_state  ${APNName} ${APNState}
    fi
fct_list_descendants()
  local children=$(ps -o pid= --ppid "$1")
  for pid in $children
    fct_list_descendants "$pid"
  done
  [ "R${children}" != "R" ] && 	echo " $children"
fct_kill_processes()
	#P1: detector binary
	local pid=$(ps -efH|grep "$1"|grep -v "grep" |head -n 1|awk '{print $2}')
	[ "R${pid}" = "R" ] && return 1
	kill -9 $(fct_list_descendants ${pid}) ${pid} &>/dev/null
	return 0
fct_check_daemon()
	#P1: RG server ip
	#P2: mqtt port
	fct_kill_processes check_rg_state.sh
	fct_kill_processes mqtt_command.sh
	#killall -9 check_rg_state.sh
	pidof check_rg_state.sh	 &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		if [ -x /bin/check_rg_state.sh ];then
			fct_echo "Info: Start check_rg_state.sh now"
			start-stop-daemon -S -b -x /bin/check_rg_state.sh -- $1 $2
		else
			fct_echo "Warning: check_rg_state.sh is unvailable"
	pidof mqtt_command.sh	 &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		if [ -x /bin/mqtt_command.sh ];then
			fct_echo "Info: Start mqtt_command.sh now"
			start-stop-daemon -S -b -x /bin/mqtt_command.sh -- $1 $2
		else
			fct_echo "Warning: mqtt_command.sh is unvailable"
fct_pub_one_state()
	APNInstance=$(echo $1|awk '{print $1}')
	APNName=$(echo $1|awk '{print $2}')
	APNState=$(echo $1|awk '{print $3}')
		flock -x 111

	)111>>$APN_STATE_FILE
	fct_check_one_apn
fct_check_apn_status()

fct_run_cmd()
	#P1: mqtt topic
	while true
		while true
			pidof mosquitto &>/dev/null
			if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
				sleep 2
			else
				break
			fi
		done
		#mosquitto_sub -h $INTERNALMQTTIP -p $INTERNALMQTTPORT -t "$1" -v |awk 'sub($1,"")'
		mosquitto_sub -h $INTERNALMQTTIP -p $INTERNALMQTTPORT -R -t "$1" -v |awk 'sub($1,"")'
		sleep 1
	done
fct_get_json()
  #P1: json file
  #P2: object path
  #P3: variable name
  local value
  value=$(cat $1|jq $2|sed 's/"//g')

    fct_echo "Failure: Failed to get $2 from $1,exit"

  eval "${3}=\${value}"
fct_process_4g_info()
	#P1: MQTTTopic
	local line level lastmsg
	lastmsg=
	while read line
		if [ "$line" != "(null)" ];then
			#Receive non-empty message
			level=$(echo "$line" | jq '.Content."4GSignalStrengthIdx"')
			level=$(echo ${level} )
			if [ "R${level}" != "R" ];then
				if [ "${lastmsg}" != "${level}" ];then
					fct_debug "Info: Publish 4G signal strength level (${level}) to $1"
					fct_publish_mqtt_msg_in_parallel "$1" "${level}" "4g"
					lastmsg="${level}"
				fi
			fi
		else
			#Receive empty message
			if [ "${lastmsg}" != "empty" ];then
				fct_debug "Info: Publish empty 4G signal strength level to $1"
				fct_publish_mqtt_msg_in_parallel "$1" "" "4g"
				lastmsg="empty"
			fi
	done
fct_process_5g_info()
	#P1: MQTTTopic
	local line level lastmsg
	lastmsg=
	while read line
		if [ "$line" != "(null)" ];then
			#Receive non-empty message
			level=$(echo "$line" | jq '.Content."5GSignalStrengthIdx"')
			level=$(echo ${level} )
			if [ "R${level}" != "R" ];then
				if [ "${lastmsg}" != "${level}" ];then
					fct_debug "Info: Publish 5G signal strength level (${level}) to $1"
					fct_publish_mqtt_msg_in_parallel "$1" "${level}" "5g"
					lastmsg="${level}"
				fi
			fi
		else
			#Receive empty message
			if [ "${lastmsg}" != "empty" ];then
				fct_debug "Info: Publish empty 5G signal strength level to $1"
				fct_publish_mqtt_msg_in_parallel "$1" "" "5g"
				lastmsg="empty"
			fi
	done

						#	[ "R${eventinfo}" != "R" ] && break

						eventinfo=NR5GSA

fct_wait_for_signal_change()
	fct_run_cmd /Device/LCD/Display/1/Screen/3/4GSignal |fct_process_4g_info "${TOPIC_4G_MOBILE_BAR_NUM}" &
	fct_run_cmd /Device/LCD/Display/1/Screen/3/5GSignal |fct_process_5g_info "${TOPIC_5G_MOBILE_BAR_NUM}" &
fct_wait_for_cellular_network_change()

fct_list_descendants()
  local children pid
  children=$(ps -o pid= --ppid "$1")
  for pid in $children
    fct_list_descendants "$pid"
  done
  [ "R${children}" != "R" ] && 	echo " $children"
fct_stop_processes()
	kill -9 $(fct_list_descendants $$) &>/dev/null
	exit 0
fct_enter_sleep()
	while true
		sleep infinity &
		wait $!
	done
fct_publish_input_apn_state()
	local APNState APNName APNInstance line lines buffered_input_apn
	if [ "${InputAPNState}" = "UP" ];then
		InputAPNState=1
	elif [ "${InputAPNState}" = "DOWN" ];then
		InputAPNState=0
	else
		log_error "Wrong input APN state (${InputAPNState}), continue"
		return
	buffered_input_apn=0
	APNName=$(cfgcli -g InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.2.X_ALU-COM_Cellular.AccessPoint.${InputAPNInstance}.APN 2>/dev/null |awk -F= '{print $2}')
	APNName=$(echo $APNName)
	if [ "${InputAPNName}" != "${APNName}" ];then
		#APN name is modified or APN instance is deleted, old APN state changes
		buffered_input_apn=1
		[ -f /tmp/buffered_apns ] && sed -i "/^${InputAPNName} /d" /tmp/buffered_apns
		echo "${InputAPNName} ${InputAPNInstance} ${InputAPNState}"  >>/tmp/buffered_apns
		fct_echo "Info: Save ${InputAPNName} ${InputAPNInstance} ${InputAPNState} in buffer"
	if [ -f /tmp/buffered_apns ];then
		lines=$(cat /tmp/buffered_apns)
		if [ "R${lines}" != "R" ];then
			while read line 
			do
				APNName=$(echo ${line} |awk '{print $1}')
				APNInstance=$(echo ${line} |awk '{print $2}')
				APNState=$(echo ${line} |awk '{print $3}')
				fct_echo "Info: Prepare to send buffered APN: ${APNName} ${APNInstance} ${APNState}"
				fct_check_oam_apn ${APNName}
				if [ "$?" -ne 0 ];then
					fct_check_service_apn ${APNName}
					if [ "$?" -eq 0 ];then
						fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${SERVICETOPIC} ${APNState}
						#MobileConnection/Service/APN/Domain : Service APN domain name
						fct_publish_mqtt_msg "${TOPIC_SERVICE_APN_DOMAIN}" "${APNName}"
						fct_echo "Info: Delete buffered APN: ${APNName} ${APNInstance} ${APNState}"
						sed -i "/^${APNName} /d" /tmp/buffered_apns
						fct_pub_service_apn_state_without_domain_username "${APNInstance}" "${APNName}" "${APNState}"
					else
						log_error "APN(${APNName}) is not OAM&Service APN"
						fct_echo "Info: Delete buffered APN: ${APNName} ${APNInstance} ${APNState}"
						sed -i "/^${APNName} /d" /tmp/buffered_apns
					fi
				else
					fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${OAMTOPIC} ${APNState}
					#MobileConnection/OAM/APN/Domain : OAM APN domain name
					fct_publish_mqtt_msg "${TOPIC_OAM_APN_DOMAIN}" "${APNName}"
					fct_echo "Info: Delete buffered APN: ${APNName} ${APNInstance} ${APNState}"
					sed -i "/^${APNName} /d" /tmp/buffered_apns
					fct_pub_oam_apn_state_without_domain "${APNName}" "${APNState}"
				fi
			done <<<"${lines}"
		else
			rm -f /tmp/buffered_apns
	if [ ${buffered_input_apn} -eq 0 ];then
		fct_check_oam_apn ${InputAPNName}
		if [ "$?" -ne 0 ];then
			fct_check_service_apn ${InputAPNName}
			if [ "$?" -eq 0 ];then
				fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${SERVICETOPIC} ${InputAPNState}
				fct_pub_service_apn_state ${InputAPNInstance} ${InputAPNName} ${InputAPNState}
			else
				log_error "APN(${InputAPNName}) is not OAM&Service APN"
			fi
		else
			fct_publish_mqtt_msg ${OAMTOPIC} ${InputAPNState}
			fct_pub_oam_apn_state ${InputAPNName} ${InputAPNState}
####################MAIN#####################
exec 1>>${LOGFILE} 2>&1
fct_echo "$0 $@"
if [ $# -ge 3 ];then
  ITF=$1
  IP4=$2
  SERVERIP4=$3
  fct_echo "Failure: Wong parameters - $@"
  exit 1

fct_check_daemon ${SERVERIP4} ${MQTTPORT}

#[ $# -ge 4 ] && fct_check_input_parameter $4
fct_check_input_parameter "$4"
if [ ${LOOP_ALLAPN} -eq 1 ];then
  fct_publish_input_apn_state
  fct_get_all_apns
  fct_check_all_apns
elif [ -f "$APN_STATE_FILE" ];then
	fct_check_apn_status

fct_get_json /etc/hb/HB_Config.json ".SysParams.MQTTListeningIPAddress" INTERNALMQTTIP

fct_echo()
  local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

  local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

fct_recover_sim()
	while true
		mipc_wan_cli  --at_cmd AT+CFUN=0 2>/dev/null|grep "AT response:"|grep ":OK" &>/dev/null
		if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
			sleep 5
			mipc_wan_cli  --at_cmd AT+EFUN=0 2>/dev/null|grep "AT response:"|grep ":OK" &>/dev/null
			if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
				mipc_wan_cli --at_cmd AT+ESIMS? 2>/dev/null|grep "AT response:"|grep "1" &>/dev/null
				if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
					fct_echo "Info: Succeed to recover USIM, restart CellularMgr"
					ubus call nokia.HAMgr ExecuteMaintenanceAction '{"Action":"StopProcess", "Process":"CellularMgr"}'
#					[ -x /etc/rc.d/S97mtk_siminit ] && fct_echo "Info: Run S97mtk_siminit" && /etc/rc.d/S97mtk_siminit start
					ubus call nokia.HAMgr ExecuteMaintenanceAction '{"Action":"StartProcess", "Process":"CellularMgr"}'
					exit 
				fi
			else
				fct_echo "Warning: Fail to run AT+EFUN=0"
			fi
		else
			fct_echo "Warning: Fail to run AT+CFUN=0"
		sleep 60
	done
###############main##############
exec 1>>${LOGFILE} 2>&1
fct_echo "Info: $0 $@"
fct_recover_sim

fct_mount_srcdir()
	#P1: mount directory
	local dev
	type mount_alt &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Warning: Fail to find mount_alt"
		return 1
	if [ ! -d $1 ];then
		mkdir -p $1
	else
		fct_umount_alt_dir $1
	mount_alt $1
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Warning: Fail to run mount_alt"
		return 1
	return 0
fct_mount_alternative_partition()
	fct_mount_srcdir /tmp/rootfs$$
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		ALTDIR=
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to mount alternative system partition"
		return 1
	else
		ALTDIR=/tmp/rootfs$$
fct_umount_alt_dir()
	type umount_alt &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
		umount_alt $1
	else
		umount $1

fct_update_country_id()
	#Change country id from jo to eu when:
	#	Product:5GGW2-OMNI-2
	#	Operator: JOUM
	#	SW rollback: Lower release(<=R2302 E0337) <- Higher release
	[ "${PRODUCT}" != "5GGW2-OMNI-2" ] && return
	[ "R${RUNNING_RELEASE}" = "R" ] && return
	[ "R${ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE}" = "R" ] && return
	[ ${RUNNING_RELEASE} -gt 230200 ] && return
	[ ${RUNNING_RELEASE} -eq 230200 ] && [ ${RUNNING_EDITION} -gt 337 ] && return	
	[ ${ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE} -lt 230200 ] && return
	[ ${ALTERNATIVE_RELEASE} -eq 230200 ] && [ ${ALTERNATIVE_EDITION} -le 337 ] && return	
	OPID=$(ri_host get OperatorID|awk '{print $2}' 2>/dev/null)
	[ "${OPID}" != "JOUM" ] && return
	CountryID=$(ri_host get CountryID|awk '{print $2}' 2>/dev/null)
	[ "${CountryID}" != "jo" ] && return
	fct_echo "Info: Update RI CountryID from jo to eu(${PRODUCT},${OPID}, ${RUNNINGVERSION}->${ALTERNATIVEVERSION})!"
	ri_host set CountryID eu
	[ $? -ne 0 ] && {
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to update RI CountryID from jo to eu"
		return
fct_write_image_into_flash()
	#P1: file type
	#P2: file path
	local size=$(stat -c %s $2)
	if [ ${size} -eq 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: $2 file size is 0, skip to write into flash"
		return 1
	local checksum=$(md5sum $2 |awk '{print $1}')
	fct_echo "Info: $1($2), size(${size}), checksum(${checksum})" 
	ipq_upgrade test flash_partition  $1 $2 ${size} ${checksum}
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Error: Fail to write $1 into flash"
		return 1
	else
		return 0
fct_check_multifota()
	fct_echo Check MultiFota : Starting!
	if [ "${DownloadImagePartition}" = "${RUNNINGPART}" ];then
		fct_echo "Info: Running on new image!"
		if [ "R${ALTDIR}" = "R" ];then
			fct_echo "Failure: Fail to mount alternative system partition, skip multifota upgrade"
			return 1
		srcdir=${ALTDIR}/etc
	elif [ "${DownloadImagePartition}" = "${ALTERNATIVEPART}" ];then
		fct_echo "Info: Running on old image, skip multifota check!"
		return 1
	else
		fct_echo "Failure: Unknown SW partition information(DownloadImagePartition=${DownloadImagePartition}, skip multifota check!"
		return 1
	if [ ! -f ${srcdir}/multifota_version ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: ${srcdir}/multifota_version is missing, skip multifota check"
		return 1
	else
		local image_multifota=$(cat ${srcdir}/multifota_version)
		image_multifota=$(echo ${image_multifota})
		if [ "R${image_multifota}" = "R" ];then
			fct_echo "Failure: ${srcdir}/multifota_version is empty, skip multifota check"
			return 1
		else
			fct_echo "Info: ${srcdir}/multifota_version : ${image_multifota}"
		local image_multifota_vers=$(cat ${srcdir}/multifota_version |awk -F_ '{print $1}')
		image_multifota_vers=$(echo ${image_multifota_vers})
		if [ "R${image_multifota_vers}" = "R" ];then
			fct_echo "Failure: Fail to get version from ${srcdir}/multifota_version, skip multifota check"
			return 1
	local flash_vers=$(fw_printenv FlashedVersion |awk -F= '{print $2}')  
	flash_vers=$(echo ${flash_vers})
	if [ "R${flash_vers}" = "R" ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to get version from flash, skip multifota check"
		return 1
	else
		fct_echo "Info: Multifota version in flash : ${flash_vers}"
	if [ "${flash_vers}" = "${image_multifota_vers}" ];then
		fct_echo "Info: Same multifota version between flash and image, skip multifota check"
		return 0
	else
		fct_echo "Info: Prepare to upgrade flash multifota to ${image_multifota_vers}"
	if [ ! -f ${srcdir}/multifota.bin ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: ${srcdir}/multifota.bin is missing, skip multifota check"
		return 1
	fct_echo "Info: Write ${srcdir}/multifota.bin into multifota partition"
	fct_write_image_into_flash multi_fota ${srcdir}/multifota.bin
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to write ${srcdir}/multifota.bin into multifota partition, skip multifota check"
		return 1
	fct_echo "Info: Set RequestedVersion to ${image_multifota_vers} and set multifota flag"
	ipq_upgrade test multifota_upgrade "${image_multifota_vers}"
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: Fail to set RequestedVersion and set multifota flag, skip multifota check"
		return 1
	fct_echo Check MultiFota : Done!    
##############################Main##############################
exec 1>>${LOGFILE} 2>&1
if [ ! -f /configs/SWMState ];then
	fct_echo "Failure: /configs/SWMState is missing"
	exit 1
fct_get_part_info
[ "${PRODUCT}" = "5GGW2-OMNI-2" ] && fct_update_country_id
[ "${PRODUCT}" = "5G-ODCPE-BHARTI" ] && fct_check_multifota

#!/bin/bash
#P1: SWUpgradeResult
# Event to OTA server
# * 0:OTA_RECONNECTBUE (Download Failure)
#   1:OTA_CRC_CHECKFAILED
# * 2:OTA_ACTIVATION_COMPLETE
#   3:OTA_ACTIVATION_FAILED
#   4:OTA_FLASH_WRITE_FAILED
# * 5:OTA_COMMIT_FAILED
# * 6:OTA_COMMIT_SUCCESS
CONF=/etc/hb/HB_Config.json
LOGFILE=/tmp/init_script.log
fct_echo()
  local date="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
  local uptime="$(cat /proc/uptime | awk '{print $1}')"
  echo "$(basename $0)[${date} ${uptime}] : ${*}" 
fct_inform_otaagent()
	#P1: SWUpgradeResult
	local rc
	type notifySwmgntEvent &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -ne 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Failure: notifySwmgntEvent is not found"
		exit 1
	while true
		pidof swmgnt &>/dev/null
		if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
			fct_echo "Info: Calling notifySwmgntEvent"
			notifySwmgntEvent $1
			rc=$?
			fct_echo "Info: Return code of notifySwmgntEvent is $rc"
			break
		else
			sleep 5
	done		
fct_run_command()
	#P1: SWUpgradeResult
	local rc
	type update_ota_info &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
		fct_echo "Info: Calling update_ota_info"
		update_ota_info $1
		rc=$?
		fct_echo "Info: Return code of update_ota_info is $rc"
	else
		fct_echo "Failure: update_ota_info is not found"
		exit 1
#######################main########################
exec 1>>${LOGFILE} 2>&1
if [ $# -ne 1 ];then
	fct_echo "Failure: Input parameter missing"
	exit 1
	fct_echo "Info: Input parameter - $@ "
QueryOTAServer=$(cat ${CONF} |jq ".SWMParams.QueryOTAServer"|sed 's/"//g')
if [ "${QueryOTAServer}" = "false" ];then
	fct_inform_otaagent $1
elif [ "${QueryOTAServer}" = "true" ];then
	fct_run_command $1
!This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
.text
